features: Invoices, expenses and payouts settle against the same records, so a month closes without reconciliation.
Approval routes are written as plain sentences rather than nested conditions, and they say who is waiting.
Every figure traces to the entry that produced it, so an audit is a query rather than a project.
faq: Yes. A change takes effect on the next invoice and the difference is prorated to the day.
Seats are included up to each plan’s limit. Beyond it, the next plan is cheaper than the overage.
What happens to our data if we leave?
It exports in full, in the format it went in, for as long as the account exists.
